topPick.thesis: Expedia Group (EXPE) is trading at 20.0x P/E, a 7% discount to its sector average of 21.6x; RSI at 59 reflects healthy bullish momentum without overextension. Three-month price momentum of +49.8% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +189% year-on-year, underpinned by a bullish MACD crossover confirming upward price pressure. Composite score of 80/100 places EXPE in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +48.5% over the past quarter.
